title: fix(app-shell): interface list toolbar honours the userActions spec defaults — Filter, Row height, Group and Hide Fields are on unless written false
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbK4zrqkvfgzpmvBDm7Q5uxL)_
Fixes #29144

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: semantic
Skills-docs: none — `git grep -n "userActions" skills/` names no interface-page toolbar default; the skills describe neither the old closed reading nor the new one

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：界面页（interface page）列表工具栏的「筛选 / 行高 / 分组 / 隐藏字段」四个开关，改为与列表视图同一份 `userActions` 规范默认值：不写即开启，写 `false` 才关闭；「行着色」仍需显式开启。ADR-0047 同步加一段修订说明。
- **为什么改**：规范把这四项默认设为开，但界面页只认显式 `true`，同一张页面经过解析就有按钮、未解析（无 userActions 块或 Studio 存储行）就没有，两种工具栏全凭页面进入控制台的路径决定。
- **风险与回滚**：没写 userActions 块的界面页、以及未解析存储的页面，会多出这四个按钮；代码包里已声明 userActions 块的示例页（showcase 11 张、HotCRM 1 张）解析后本来就有分组和隐藏字段，无变化。回滚即还原 `InterfaceListPage.tsx` 一处映射。
- **先看**：`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/InterfaceListPage.tsx`（userActions 映射那段）；`docs/adr/0047-object-ui-run-modes.md`（修订横幅）；`.changeset/29144-interface-toolbar-spec-defaults.md`。
- **两分钟验证**：`cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/InterfaceListPage.userActionsSpecDefaults.test.tsx`，预期 17 个用例全绿。
- **需要你做的**：本 PR 触及 `docs/adr/**`（Tier H），待席位 ACCEPT 后请审阅并批准合并。

## What changes

- `InterfaceListPage` reads `filter`, `rowHeight`, `group` and `hideFields` from the page's `interfaceConfig.userActions` as `!== false`, the published default of `UserActionsConfigSchema` (the schema a list view's `userActions` uses too). `search` and `sort` already read this way. `rowColor`, off by default in the spec, stays `=== true`. Export stays off.
- A page with no `userActions` block, a stored page that was never parsed, and a parsed block that omits a key now draw the same toolbar. Before, only the parsed block drew the four controls, because the parse had written the default `true` that `=== true` was waiting for.
- ADR-0047 gets a dated amendment banner and status note under the maintainer's ruling (#29144 comment 6574404727, batch #455, letter A): the toolbar toggles take the shared defaults; §3.4's closed rows (quick filters, visualization lock, no user-created views, session filter state) and the export lock stand. `docs/adr/README.md` is regenerated by `pnpm adr:index`.
- The sentence "an interface page keeps its own closed-by-default toolbar" is corrected in three places: the `list-view-hide-fields-default-on` semantic entry, the default-change ledger reason (`packages/spec/scripts/lib/default-changes.ts`) and the still-pending changeset `.changeset/28912-hide-fields-default-on.md` (one bullet), which would otherwise publish the now-false sentence.

### Reach (measured at 49aba82b)

| Pages | userActions block | Today | After |
|---|---|---|---|
| showcase `active-projects`, `review-queue`, `task-triage`, `task-workbench` and the seven `task-visualizations` pages (11 pages); HotCRM `account_workbench` | declared, omits `group` / `hideFields` | parsed by `defineStack`: Group and Hide Fields already drawn | unchanged |
| any page with no block; any stored page never parsed (Studio drafts and rows) | absent or unparsed | none of the four drawn | Filter, Row height, Group, Hide Fields drawn unless written `false` |

The parse reading: `PageSchema.parse` of a block `{ sort, search, filter: false, rowHeight: false, addRecordForm: false }` yields `group: true` and `hideFields: true`; a page with no block parses with none.

## Tests

- New `InterfaceListPage.userActionsSpecDefaults.test.tsx` (17 cases): no block, an unparsed `{}` and a parsed `{}` (through the real `PageSchema`) compose the same spec-default toolbar; a curated block composes the same toolbar parsed or unparsed; an explicit `false` withholds each of the four alone; an explicit `true` keeps each; for four blocks the page draws exactly what a list view parses the same block to (`UserActionsConfigSchema.parse`); `rowColor` stays opt-in.
- A list view is unchanged: `ListView.test.tsx` (its `hideFields` default-on, explicit `false` and `group: false` cases) runs green beside the page tests.
- `InterfaceListPage.relayCensus-11572.test.ts`: the `userActions` and `compactToolbar` reasons no longer say "closed by default".
- Ablation: restoring `hideFields: userActions.hideFields === true` (through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, anchor 1 → 0, replacement 0 → 1) turns 8 of 17 cases red on the final head (the parsed-`{}` case stays green under the ablation, which is the defect: only a parse made the old read draw the control); the restored blob equals HEAD and `git diff HEAD` is empty.

## Acceptance notes

- A list view's toolbar is unchanged: `ListView` already reads these four as `!== false`; this diff does not touch `@object-ui/plugin-list`.
- **`check-empty-changeset` stays red on purpose.** This PR edits `.changeset/28912-hide-fields-default-on.md`, a pending release note it did not add. That is the gate's DELIBERATE CORRECTION class: the note's interface-page bullet said the page keeps a closed-by-default toolbar, which this change makes false, so restoring it would publish a false sentence. The one bullet now says the page reads the same default and `hideFields: false` withholds the control. The correction is named in the claim amendment (#29144 comment 6574419950) under the maintainer's ruling; the maintainer confirms it with the Tier H approval.
